subject: Urgent: HelixCore deploy caused throughput spike + errors — CTO bridge requested
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: HelixCore production deploy -> throughput + 5xx spike (need immediate bridge)

Team —

HelixCore reported a deployment earlier this morning (modelpack v3.8 + int8 profile) and we started seeing a sustained 20% throughput increase and a 10x 5xx rate on their hotpath between 08:30–08:50 PT. They are on Dedicated v2 pool (pinned model v3.8-int8).

I pulled the quick traces — CPU contended on the server-side batcher and we have large KV cache misses from the new pack. Suspect quantization profile interaction with recent kernel change.

Irene — can you pull the full node-level logs and perf counters (batch size distribution, kernel selection histogram) and upload to Drive? Vanessa — please loop support to get HelixCore on a short CTO bridge; they want exec attention. Grace — we should prepare a one-pager for the call (impact, rollback options, timeline).

Attaching the partial logs I grabbed.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: service-logs-20260720.zip (log bundle, truncated)
From: HelixCore Support <support@helixcore.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@helixcore.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelixCore production deploy -> throughput + 5xx spike (need immediate bridge)

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the heads-up. We started seeing user-facing timeouts and elevated 502/504 rates right after the deploy. Samir is on-site and can join a bridge now. We can roll back if you recommend, but would appreciate your ops guidance — your notes about KV cold misses match what we observed on our side (cache TTLs wiped during migration).

Samir (CTO) is available at +1-415-555-0199.

— HelixCore Support
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@helixcore.ai>, HelixCore Support <support@helixcore.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelixCore production deploy -> throughput + 5xx spike (need immediate bridge)

Samir / team —

We recommend a brief CTO bridge now so we can align on rollback vs mitigation. Options:
- Roll back to modelpack v3.7 (safe, will restore prior kernel/quant path) — ~10–15 min for routing + warm-up.
- Keep v3.8 but switch to fp16 profile (avoids int8 path, may increase cost) — quick config flip, watch KV misses.
- Short-term traffic shaping to reduce concurrency on hot endpoints while we patch the kernel selection logic.

Irene: target analysis in 30 min and we will propose the safest path. Vanessa: can you set up DocuSign + exec bridge invite? Grace: creating the one-pager (impact, metrics, recommended path) and will share in Slack.

K
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T10:32:00-07:00
Subject: RE: HelixCore production deploy -> throughput + 5xx spike (need immediate bridge)

Quick findings (30-min triage):
- Node logs: kernel choice for several accelerated ops switched to the new int8 kernel on v3.8 for sequence lengths >128; that kernel currently shows 2–3x slower tail latency on our stress harness for specific attention patterns.
- KV cache: migration cleared prefix caches during rolling deploy; HelixCore has a very skewed prefix distribution which amplifies cold miss costs.
- Batcher: under the new kernel, we observed higher variability in token generation time which caused the batcher to hold up more concurrent work -> cascade into timeouts.

Attachments: perf-summary-pt1.pdf (quick perf counters and heatmap).

Recommendation: revert to v3.7 immediately for production traffic and schedule a controlled canary of v3.8-int8 behind a traffic cap while we instrument and fix kernel path.

Irene
Senior Applied ML Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@helixcore.ai>, HelixCore Support <support@helixcore.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: HelixCore production deploy -> throughput + 5xx spike (need immediate bridge) — Exec summary + next steps

Samir — thanks again for the fast coordination on the bridge earlier. Recap and next steps for execs: 

Impact: ~18% throughput variance on hotpath, 9–12% of requests saw 5xx/timeouts during the 20-minute window. No data exfiltration or persistence issues.

Root cause: interaction between v3.8-int8 kernel selection and HelixCore's skewed prefix distribution combined with cache migration during rolling deploy. The int8 kernel increases variance in decode time for long-prefix attention patterns we saw in your traffic.

Actions taken:
- Rolled back traffic to v3.7 at 10:20 PT (routing + warm-up).
- Opened OPS ticket OPS-9812 and provided logs/heatmaps.
- Engineering will run a closed canary of v3.8-int8 behind a 10% traffic cap with enhanced KV warm-up and additional micro-batching controls.

Ask of HelixCore execs: please approve a scheduled 2-hour maintenance window this week to run the canary and allow us to test the updated kernel with real traffic patterns. We'll provide pre-window validation checks and a safety rollback plan.

I'll follow up with calendar invites and the one-pager. Appreciate the patience — we know this hit your users and we are treating it as a Sev2 with exec visibility.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Related: JIRA OPS-9812, Drive logs folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1a2b3c-helixcore-logs
